final: WITH g AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes WHERE observstation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.observstation, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM k
